home.heroTagline: Sprayers we build in-house — backed by every spare part
home.heroSubtitle: Yoon Fatt Industries manufactures and assembles the complete SOFA range of knapsack sprayers in our own factory — and makes every spare part to keep them running. Serving farms, estates and dealers across East & West Malaysia since 1949.
home.highlightQualityBody: Every SOFA sprayer is manufactured and assembled in our own factory — not rebadged, not outsourced.
home.highlightProcessBody: From the tank to the smallest O-ring, we make the full parts range — so a worn part never turns your sprayer into scrap.
home.highlightPricingBody: Buy straight from the manufacturer. Long-lasting, replaceable parts keep your total cost of ownership low.
home.featuredSubtitle: A selection from our range of sprayers, nozzles, and spare parts.
home.heritageBody: Three generations of manufacturing experience stand behind every product we build.
home.contactStripTitle: Visit us or get in touch
home.howToOrderSubtitle: No account and no online payment — just a quick enquiry, and our sales team takes care of the rest.
home.orderStep1Body: Browse the catalogue and add the sprayers or spare parts you need. Ask about price, parts, or delivery — anything.
home.orderStep2Body: Submit your enquiry list in one tap. It reaches us instantly with your requirements.
home.orderStep3Body: Our sales team gets back to you with pricing, availability, and delivery details.
